name: Flame Arrow
short: Your left click: instant fire hit at 20 m that gives back 100 MP. Opens the Detonation / Heat Surge chain.
desc: Deals fire damage to a target within 20 m and restores 100 MP.

name: Detonation
short: Second hit of the left-click chain, option 1 of 2. Same 100 MP return as Flame Arrow.
desc: Deals fire damage to a target within 20 m and restores 100 MP.

name: Heat Surge
short: The other second hit of the left-click chain, and the bigger mana return: 120 MP.
desc: Deals fire damage to a target within 20 m and restores 120 MP.

name: Ice Chain
short: Water AoE that slows 4 targets for 5 s at -40% movement speed: the condition the Cold Summon passive feeds on.
desc: Deals water damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target at 20 m and slows them for 5 s at -40% movement speed. Groggy gauge damage: 2.

name: Cold Wave
short: Ice Chain's chain follow-up: the same 4-target water AoE with no control attached.
desc: Deals water damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target at 20 m. Groggy gauge damage: 2.

name: Flame Harpoon
short: Single-target fire nuke. Inven's name_en is Flame Harpoon; the skills guide calls it Firestorm.
desc: Deals fire damage to a target within 20 m. Groggy gauge damage: 5.

name: Bitter Cold Wind
short: Ground-targeted wind lasting 2 s that roots up to 4 enemies for 3 s at 60% (100% on NPCs).
desc: Summons a bitter cold wind at the position of a target within 20 m, lasting 2 s. The wind deals water damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of itself and roots them for 3 s with a 60% chance. Against NPCs the root lands at 100%. Groggy gauge damage: 10.

name: Blaze
short: Only fires against a Fire-Marked target. Returns 100 MP: the payoff of the Fire Mark passive.
desc: Deals fire damage to a Fire-Marked target within 20 m and restores 100 MP. Groggy gauge damage: 7.

name: Flame Scatter Shot
short: Only fires against a groggy target: free fire damage during the groggy window.
desc: Deals fire damage to a groggy target within 20 m.

name: Frost
short: Water AoE with a 40% freeze for 3 s (100% on NPCs). It is what sets up Frost Burst.
desc: Deals water damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target at 20 m and freezes it for 3 s with a 40% chance. Against NPCs the freeze lands at 100%. Groggy gauge damage: 10.

name: Winter Shackles
short: Water AoE with a guaranteed 3 s slow: no chance roll, unlike Frost.
desc: Deals water damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target at 20 m and slows them for 3 s.

name: Frost Burst
short: Only fires against a frozen target: Frost's payoff. Against control-immune targets it still procs 7% of the time.
desc: Deals water damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a frozen target at 20 m. Against control-immune targets it activates with a 7% chance on hit. Groggy gauge damage: 7.

name: Wish of Concentration
short: Self-buff: +10% attack and +100 accuracy for 10 s. The only skill in the kit whose visible numbers scale per rank.
desc: For 10 s, your attack increases by 10% and your accuracy by 100.
rank20: The duration goes from 10 s to 19.5 s, half a second per rank.

name: Hellfire
short: 3-stage charge skill: 4-target fire AoE and the biggest groggy contribution in the kit (20 to 35).
desc: Deals fire damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target at 20 m. Maximum 3 charge stages. Groggy gauge damage: 20 to 35.

name: Shock Release
short: Your only real defensive: cleanses stun, knockdown, air-bind, grab, freeze and fear, then 5 s of status immunity.
desc: Clears your stun, knockdown, airborne bind, grab, freeze and fear states and gives you Tenacity for 5 s. Tenacity: immunity to status effects.
rank20: The cooldown drops from 1 min to 41 s.

name: Curse: Ancient Tree
short: Shock Release's chain: turns the target into a tree for 7 s at -20% fire resistance and pushes you backwards.
desc: Turns a target within 20 m into a tree for 7 s with -20% fire resistance, and displaces you backwards. The tree loses the effect if it takes a hit.
rank20: The cooldown drops from 2 min to 1 min 22 s.

name: Fire Mark
short: Fire hits have a 20% chance to mark the target for 5 s. Marked targets take 20% extra fire damage and unlock Blaze.
desc: Every time a fire attack lands, 20% chance to leave the target in the Fire Mark state for 5 s. Fire Mark: if the target takes fire damage while marked, 20% chance of bonus damage. Internal cooldown: 1 s.

name: Robe of Earth
short: +7% max mana, +5 mana regen, and +105 critical while your mana is at 50% or more.
desc: Your max mana increases by 7%, your mana regeneration by 5, and when your mana is at 50% or more your critical increases by 105.
rank20: +45% max mana, +100 mana regen and +200 critical.

name: Cold Summon
short: Extra damage 50% of the time against slowed targets: Ice Chain's and Winter Shackles' payoff.
desc: Every time an attack lands on a slowed target, 50% chance to deal damage. Internal cooldown: 1 s.
rank20: No visible change: the database publishes no damage figure.

name: Robe of Flame
short: +100 accuracy, +1% PvE, +0.5% PvP, +0.2% Smite. The first passive in every queue, for the rank-20 curve.
desc: Your accuracy increases by 100, your PvE damage amplification by 1%, your PvP by 0.5% and your Smite by 0.2%.

name: Essence Absorption
short: +12% physical and mental accuracy, and 11 MP back on every attack that lands: your mana engine.
desc: Your physical and mental accuracy increases by 12% and you restore 11 MP every time an attack lands.

name: Grace of Resistance
short: +11.5% mental and shock resistance: pure anti-chain-control.
desc: Your mental resistance and your shock resistance increase by 11.5%.
rank20: Mental and shock resistance go from +11.5% to +40%.

name: Robe of Frost
short: +1% defence, +55 crit resistance, and anyone who attacks you gets slowed 2 s at -25%. Internal cooldown 10 s.
desc: Your defence increases by 1%, your critical resistance by 55, and every time an enemy attacks you, you slow it for 2 s at -25% movement speed. Internal cooldown: 10 s.
rank20: +20% defence, +150 critical resistance and a -55% slow for 6.5 s.

name: Grace of Enhancement
short: Above 25% mana: +20% PvE and +10% PvP damage amplification, plus a 50% chance of bonus damage on hit.
desc: When your mana is at 25% or more, your PvE damage amplification increases by 20% and your PvP by 10%, and on an attack hit you have a 50% chance of dealing bonus damage. Internal cooldown: 1 s.

name: Contract of Revival
short: +17% status resistance, stacking while you are controlled, plus an automatic 35% heal below 10% HP.
desc: Your status resistance increases by 17% and, when you take a hit while stunned, knocked down, airborne-bound, frozen or feared, you gain +10% status resistance for 5 s, stacking 10 times. At 10% HP or less you instantly restore 35% of max HP. Internal cooldowns: 1 min heal, 1 s resistance.

name: Vitality Evaporation
short: Bonus damage on hit while the target is above 70% HP: an opener passive, not an execute.
desc: On hit, deals bonus damage if the target's HP is above 70%.
rank20: The threshold widens from above 70% HP to above 51%.

name: Divine Burst
short: Stigma. Single-target fire hit with the biggest groggy contribution in the kit: 50.
desc: Deals fire damage to a target within 20 m. Groggy gauge damage: 50.

name: Steel Barrier
short: Stigma. A 1 min shield blocking 2424 damage, +10% PvE and +5% PvP tolerance, and 300 stamina back when it ends.
desc: For 1 min, generates a shield that blocks 2424 damage. While it lasts, your PvE damage tolerance increases by 10% and your PvP by 5%. When the effect ends, you restore 300 stamina.
rank20: The shield goes from 2424 to 8188 damage.

name: Element Enhancement
short: Stigma. +10% fire attack and +10% water attack for 10 s: the damage window the whole rotation is built around.
desc: For 10 s, your fire attack increases by 10% and your water attack by 10%.
rank20: The duration goes from 10 s to 20 s.

name: Curse: Tree
short: Stigma. Turns the target into a tree for 10 s at -20% fire resistance and pushes you backwards. It breaks on any hit.
desc: Turns a target within 20 m into a tree for 10 s with -20% fire resistance, and displaces you backwards. The tree loses the effect if it takes a hit. Groggy gauge damage: 20.
rank20: The cooldown drops from 1 min 30 s to 1 min 11 s.

name: Arctic Armor
short: Stigma. 10 s of +20% PvE and +10% PvP tolerance, a 5% freeze on attackers, and Mana Conversion above 50% mana.
desc: For 10 s, your PvE damage tolerance increases by 20% and your PvP by 10%, and with a 5% chance you freeze for 3 s the enemies attacking you within 7 m. While it lasts, above 50% mana you get Mana Conversion: 50% of the damage you take is absorbed by your HP and 10% by your mana. Not affected by cooldown-increasing effects.
rank20: The duration goes from 10 s to 20 s.

name: Soul Freeze
short: Stigma. 75% chance to seal the target for 5 s (100% on NPCs): it locks the target's skills.
desc: Deals water damage to a target within 20 m and seals it for 5 s with a 75% chance. Against NPCs the seal lands at 100%. Groggy gauge damage: 20.

name: Cold Storm
short: Stigma. 5 m AoE slow plus a 7 s ground storm that keeps applying Frostbite, a water DoT that grows if the target moves.
desc: Deals water damage to up to 4 enemies within 5 m of a target at 20 m and slows them. Summons a cold storm at the target's position lasting 7 s that keeps applying Frostbite. Frostbite: water damage every second for 10 s, and more damage if the target is moving. Groggy gauge damage: 20.

name: Firewall
short: Stigma. A 1x10 m wall for 3 s that leaves up to 4 enemies in Ember: fire damage over time that grows if they move.
desc: Summons a fire wall at the position of a target within 20 m, lasting 3 s. The wall damages up to 4 enemies inside its 1x10 m area and leaves them in Ember for 10 s. Ember: fire damage every second for 10 s, and more damage if the target is moving.

name: Lumiel's Space
short: Stigma. 4-target AoE that air-binds for 3 s with a 75% chance (100% on NPCs): your hardest control.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target at 20 m and airborne-binds them for 3 s with a 75% chance. Against NPCs the airborne bind lands at 100%.

name: Delayed Explosion
short: Stigma. Fire damage 4 s later, and during the delay the target takes 15% more damage from you: a burst opener.
desc: Deals fire damage to a target within 20 m after 4 s. During that delay the target takes 15% more damage from the caster.

name: Glacial Smite
short: Stigma. Plain 4-target water AoE with no control, worth 20 groggy gauge.
desc: Deals water damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target at 20 m. Groggy gauge damage: 20.

name: Assault Bombardment
short: Stigma. 4-target AoE with a 30% freeze that also gives you up to +20% defence, scaling with how many you hit.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target at 20 m and freezes them for 3 s with a 30% chance. Against NPCs the freeze lands at 100%. Your defence increases by up to 20% in proportion to the number of targets hit.

name: Hibernation
short: Stigma. 5 s of total invulnerability. Cancelling it early heals 20% of max HP and pushes you backwards.
desc: For 5 s you enter hibernation. While it lasts you take no damage and cannot be hit by status effects. Using the cancel skill during hibernation ends it instantly, restores 20% of your max HP and displaces you backwards. Some very powerful attacks cannot be blocked by it.
rank20: The cooldown drops from 3 min to 2 min 22 s.
